name: Drowned Ruins of Ys'Thara
description: An ancient city beneath the waves, filled with dark magic and aquatic horrors.

diving_point.title: Surface - Diving Point
diving_point.description: Your boat rocks gently above the ruins. Below, green-lit structures shimmer in the depths. You don your diving gear and descend into the cold, dark water.

outer_ruins.title: Outer Ruins - Flooded Plaza
outer_ruins.description: Crumbling buildings loom out of the murk. Fish dart between broken columns. The water here is thick with silt and old magic. Passages lead deeper into the city in all directions.

encounters.description: Two sahuagin guards patrol the ruins!

collapsed_district.title: Collapsed District
collapsed_district.description: Buildings have fallen here, creating a maze of rubble. Something large has made a lair among the debris. A dark fissure leads deeper into the abyss below.

encounters.description: A massive octopus emerges from the rubble!

temple_approach.title: Temple Approach
temple_approach.description: A wide avenue leads to the Temple of the Serpent's Fang. Statues of ancient rulers line the path, their faces eroded by time and water. Cultist divers work at the temple entrance. To the north, the old market district beckons.

encounters.description: Cult divers turn to attack, weapons drawn!

temple_entrance.title: Serpent Temple - Outer Chamber
temple_entrance.description: The temple interior is eerily preserved. Green bioluminescent algae provides ghostly light. Serpent carvings cover every surface. Water flows through channels in the floor. To the east, an ornate archway leads toward what was once the royal palace.

encounters.description: Cultists and their elemental guardian attack!

ritual_chamber.title: Ritual Chamber of the Fang
ritual_chamber.description: The heart of the temple. A massive altar carved from black coral dominates the chamber. High Priest Morvathis stands before it, the Fifth Key in one hand and the Serpent's Fang in the other. His eyes glow with unnatural power as he completes his incantation.

encounters.description: High Priest Morvathis turns from his ritual! 'You're too late! The Fang is mine, and soon the Serpent will rise!' An aboleth spawn emerges from the depths to aid him!

residential_quarter.title: Residential Quarter - Central Street
residential_quarter.description: Ancient homes line this flooded street, their windows dark and empty. Kelp grows through doorways, and small fish dart in and out of broken windows. The buildings are eerily preserved, as if the residents simply vanished.

ancient_homes.title: Ancient Homes - Haunted Dwellings
ancient_homes.description: Several homes cluster together here. Inside, furniture remains in place, covered in silt. Ghostly echoes whisper through the water—the drowned spirits of Ys'Thara, unable to move on. They don't attack, but their presence is deeply unsettling.

encounters.description: Drowned spirits materialize from the walls, their eyes filled with ancient sorrow and rage!

nobles_villa.title: Noble's Villa - Preserved Estate
nobles_villa.description: This grand villa belonged to a wealthy merchant lord. Unlike other buildings, it has been magically preserved—carpets still plush, paintings still vibrant. A protective enchantment kept the water at bay... until recently. The cult has looted much, but secrets remain.

encounters.description: Two suits of ornate armor animate and attack—the villa's guardians still defend their lord's treasures!

cult_excavation.title: Cult Excavation Site - Operations Hub
cult_excavation.description: The cult has established a base here. Ropes and pulleys connect to the surface, and crates of artifacts are staged for retrieval. A foreman oversees work crews sorting treasures and ancient texts. This is the logistical heart of the cult's underwater operation.

encounters.description: The cult foreman shouts orders! 'Intruders! Protect the artifacts!' Divers rush to attack!

diving_bell_chamber.title: Diving Bell Chamber - Equipment Storage
diving_bell_chamber.description: Large diving bells hang suspended in the water, connected to air hoses leading to the surface. Shelves hold diving equipment, waterbreathing potions, and underwater tools. This is how the cult has been able to work at such depths for extended periods.

prisoner_holding.title: Prisoner Holding - Mind-Control Cells
prisoner_holding.description: Iron cages hold a dozen victims—fisherfolk and divers who got too close to the ruins. But they're not prisoners anymore... they're thralls. The aboleth has touched their minds, and they serve the cult willingly now, their eyes glazed and empty.

encounters.description: The thralls turn toward you with dead eyes. They attack without hesitation, slaves to an alien will!

market_ruins.title: Market Ruins - Sunken Bazaar
market_ruins.description: Stalls and shop fronts line this once-bustling market square. Goods still sit on shelves, perfectly preserved by the cold water—spices, fabrics, trinkets. Sahuagin have claimed this area, using it to store salvage and trophies from their raids.

encounters.description: A sahuagin chieftain and his warriors defend their territory!

warehouse_ruins.title: Warehouse Ruins - Contraband Storage
warehouse_ruins.description: This massive warehouse once stored merchant goods. Now it's filled with contraband—smuggled weapons, illegal alchemical substances, and stolen artifacts. The cult has been using it to store items they don't want on the surface.

encounters.description: Cult guards protecting the contraband spot you and attack!

smugglers_grotto.title: Smuggler's Grotto - Hidden Cache
smugglers_grotto.description: A hidden cave behind false barrels. This was the smuggler's true treasure vault—not cult related, but ancient. Coins, jewelry, and a few magical items are sealed in waterproof chests. A skeleton in fine clothes suggests the smuggler never made it out to retrieve his fortune.

palace_gardens.title: Royal Palace - Drowned Gardens
palace_gardens.description: Once beautiful gardens now grow wild underwater. Kelp forests replace manicured hedges, and bioluminescent plants create an eerie, beautiful glow. Aquatic creatures have made homes in the fountains and ponds. The palace itself looms to the north, its bronze doors still sealed.

encounters.description: Massive crabs defend their garden territory!

throne_room.title: Royal Throne Room - Hall of Kings
throne_room.description: The throne of Ys'Thara sits upon a dais, a skeleton still seated upon it wearing a coral crown. Murals depict the city's glory days. Two massive stone golems flank the throne—ancient guardians that still function after a thousand years.

encounters.description: The stone golems activate with grinding sounds! Their eyes glow red as they move to defend the throne!

treasury_vault.title: Royal Treasury - Vault of Ys'Thara
treasury_vault.description: The royal treasury. Gold, platinum, gems, and magical artifacts fill this chamber. But the cult has gotten here first—many treasures are gone. What remains is still valuable, but deadly traps protect it. The floor is littered with skeletal remains of looters who failed.

encounters.description: Pressure plates trigger poison dart traps! Roll DEX save (DC 18) or take 3d6 poison damage and be poisoned for 1 hour.

royal_archives.title: Royal Archives - Hall of Knowledge
royal_archives.description: Waterproof stone tablets and sealed scroll cases line the walls. The history of Ys'Thara is recorded here—including the truth of why it sank. The last king made a pact with an aboleth, trading the city for immortality. The aboleth kept its bargain... in a way.

aboleth_lair.title: The Abyss - Aboleth's Domain
aboleth_lair.description: You descend into crushing darkness. The water here is ancient and wrong—thick with psychic energy. An enormous aboleth floats in the void, its three eyes glowing with malevolent intelligence. This is the creature that sank Ys'Thara, and it guards treasures beyond measure. Fighting it here, in its domain, is extremely dangerous.

encounters.description: The ancient aboleth turns its terrible gaze upon you! Its psychic voice reverberates in your skull: 'You dare enter my domain? Join the city in eternal servitude!' This is an optional boss fight—extremely dangerous!
